documents.population: International students applying for undergraduate courses at Birmingham (via UCAS), including BSc Computer Science
documents.notes: University of Birmingham 'Your journey to Birmingham' international page (Phase 2: University application process, 'Supporting documents', which applies to undergraduate and postgraduate applicants alike) and the undergraduate 'Apply' page (September 2027 entry, UCAS deadline 13 January 2027). The supporting-documents sentence lists all five documents together; each item quotes the part that names it. Not drafted: the after-admission documents (CAS, visa documents, passport-style photo for the student ID, Right to Study). Applicants from schools not registered with UCAS are responsible for their own application, including the reference. Round 2's guessed URL (/undergraduate/applying) answered 404; these are the current paths.

items.quote: For all undergraduate courses at Birmingham, you apply online through UCAS.
you will need to provide us with some supporting documents: These supporting documents will include a results' transcript,
a results' transcript, personal statement, your references
personal statement, your references, copy of your English language certificate if needed
copy of your English language certificate if needed, as well as a copy of your passport details.
